Pure Triton now has a fused MoE dispatch kernel that beats CUDA-optimized Megablocks for inference.

This is a significant leap for MoE efficiency. Optimizing execution at common batch sizes without vendor-specific CUDA is a serious win for both performance and portability.

Details: https://www.reddit.com/r/MachineLearning/comments/1sdaknc/p_fused_moe_dispatch_in_pure_triton_beating/
#LLMOps #Inference #MLOps

A new LLM load balancer routes requests based on inflight tokens, not just active connections.

This directly solves a major pain point in LLM inference scaling. Different prompt/completion lengths create highly variable processing times, making simple connection-based balancing useless for consistent throughput.

More here: https://github.com/SivagurunathanV/token-aware-balancer

An AI agent "ran" a startup for 35 days, generating 315 sessions and precisely zero dollars.

This is the real state of "autonomous agents" today. They execute tasks, but lack the true strategic reasoning, improvisation, and iterative learning required to navigate a real market. Automation is not autonomy.

Full story: https://agentfounder.ai/blog
